Fisher Asset Management Has Cut Advanced Semiconductor Eng Adr (ASX) Stake by $3.96 Million; Rgm Capital Decreased Its Verint Systems (VRNT) Stake by $11.63 Million as Stock Price Rose 
March 22, 2018 - By Nellie Frank 
Robert G. Moses decreased its stake in Verint Systems Inc (VRNT) by 15.41% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Rgm Capital Llc sold 283,644 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.30% with the market. The hedge fund run by Robert G. Moses held 1.56M shares of the edp services company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $65.16 million, down from 1.84M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Rgm Capital Llc who had been investing in Verint Systems Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $2.49 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.26% or $0.1   $39.05. About 236,092 shares traded. Verint Systems Inc. (NASDAQ:VRNT) has risen 23.95%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.25% the S&P500. 
Ken Fisher decreased its stake in Advanced Semiconductor Eng Adr (ASX) by 2.11% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Fisher Asset Management Llc sold 659,345 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.80% with the market. The hedge fund run by Ken Fisher held 30.57M shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $188.94M, down from 31.23 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Fisher Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Advanced Semiconductor Eng Adr for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $12.40B market cap company. The stock increased 2.36% or $0.17   $7.38. About 784,741 shares traded. Advanced Semiconductor Engineering, Inc. (NYSE:ASX) has risen 38.27%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 21.57% the S&P500. 
Among 3 analysts covering Advanced Semiconductor Engineering ( NYSE:ASX ), 2 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 67% are positive. Advanced Semiconductor Engineering had 3   May 31, 2016   The rating was upgraded by UBS on Tuesday, May 31 to “Buy”. The company was upgraded on Thursday, May 26 by Nomura. Goldman Sachs downgraded Advanced Semiconductor Engineering, Inc. (NYSE:ASX) on Friday, November 25 to “Neutral” rating. 
Fisher Asset Management Llc, which manages about $71.30 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Merck& Co Inc (NYSE:MRK) by 192,007 shares to 7.29 million shares, valued at $466.93M in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 329,794 shares in the quarter, for a total of 10.89M shares, and has risen its stake in Anheuser Busch Inbev Sa/Nv Adr (NYSE:BUD). 
Analysts await Verint Systems Inc. (NASDAQ:VRNT) to report earnings on March, 27. They expect $0.77 earnings per share, up 20.31% or $0.13 from last year’s $0.64 per share. VRNT’s profit will be $49.12 million for 12.68 P/E if the $0.77 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.41 actual earnings per share reported by Verint Systems Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 87.80% EPS growth. 
By1 Nellie Frank
